caption: The drawing depicts a long, full-length robe with long, wide sleeves. The garment features a pattern consisting of alternating vertical stripes in green, brown, and beige hues, with some of the stripes displaying plaid or textured details. The robe has a fitted upper bodice, gathered at the waist, and is cinched at the middle, giving it a slight flare below. Two large decorative tassels are attached at the waist area on the left side. The collar is round and adorned with white lace, adding a delicate detail at the neckline. The interior surface of the sleeves is a solid greenish-blue, visible where the fabric folds back. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color, and there are no other objects or decorations present.
title: Woman's Dress
